children: Bharat Electronics Limited (NSE:BEL) posted Q1 standalone net profit of ₹1,054 crore on revenue of ₹5,533 crore with a 25.1% EBITDA margin, won ₹533 crore of new defence and tech orders since Sept 17, 2026, plans to raise authorised capital, and sees no material hit from Israel-linked contracts.
: Bharat Electronics Limited Q1 standalone: net profit ₹1,054 crore (+8.8% YoY), revenue ₹5,533 crore (+25.3% YoY), EBITDA ₹1,389.2 crore, EBITDA margin 25.1%.

: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) secured new orders worth Rs 533 crore since Sept 17, 2026, for communications gear, avionics, cybersecurity, drones, jammers, software, upgrades, spares and services.
: Bharat Electronics (BEL) board approved raising authorised share capital from ₹750 crore to ₹1,000 crore by creating new ₹1 face-value equity shares, pending shareholder approval at the AGM.
BEL Israel Contracts Evaluation Finds No Impact
: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) reviewed Israel-linked contracts amid the conflict and found no material financial impact on its existing agreements as of the reported results date.
